accidental_death.value: Option A. Rider sum assured paid on accidental death of the life assured within 180 days of the accident. Benefit is payable even if death falls after the rider term, if the accident happened while the rider was in force.
accidental_death.doc: SBI Life - Accident Benefit Rider - Linked Brochure/Prospectus
accidental_death.quote: we will pay the Rider Sum Assured for AD Benefit

accidental_disability.value: Option B, partial permanent disability only. Percentage of rider sum assured by injury, for example 75% for loss of hearing in both ears, 50% for loss of one eye, 30% for hearing in one ear. Within 180 days of the accident. No total permanent disability option.
accidental_disability.doc: SBI Life - Accident Benefit Rider - Linked Brochure/Prospectus

other.value: If a benefit option is already inbuilt in the base policy, the rider does not offer it. Can be added at a later policy anniversary for regular and limited pay policies.
other.doc: SBI Life - Accident Benefit Rider - Linked Brochure/Prospectus
other.quote: the same benefit option shall not be offered under the rider

rider_term.value: Minimum 1 year, maximum 75 less age at entry, and not beyond the outstanding base policy term. Rider premium payment term equals the base policy premium payment term (outstanding term if added later).
rider_term.doc: SBI Life - Accident Benefit Rider - Linked Brochure/Prospectus

premium_paying_rules.value: Single, limited or regular, aligned with the base policy. Modes follow the base policy. Half-yearly 51%, quarterly 25.5%, monthly 8.5% of annual premium. Rider premium is level and guaranteed.
premium_paying_rules.doc: SBI Life - Accident Benefit Rider - Linked Brochure/Prospectus

entry_age.doc: SBI Life - Accident Benefit Rider - Linked Brochure/Prospectus

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 50,000 or the base policy minimum if lower. Maximum Rs 2 crore for accidental death (at most 3 times the base sum assured) and Rs 1.5 crore for APPD (at most the base sum assured).
sum_assured_limits.doc: SBI Life - Accident Benefit Rider - Linked Brochure/Prospectus

premium_deduction.value: Separate rider premium, payable in addition to the base premium with the same due date. Cannot be paid on its own. Not deducted from the fund.
premium_deduction.doc: SBI Life - Accident Benefit Rider - Linked Brochure/Prospectus
premium_deduction.quote: Rider premium shall be payable in addition to the premium payable under the base policy.
